Job Description
Religious Program Specialists serve with Navy, Marine Corps, and Joint Services ashore and afloat; contribute to the Command Religious Program (CRP)
by assisting in the delivery of Religious Ministry (RM), consistent with the principles of Professional Naval Chaplaincy (PNC) that contribute to the
Spiritual Readiness (SR) of warfighters and their families; perform under the direct or indirect supervision of chaplains to assist in the provision and
facilitation of RM; support the delivery of resilience and life-skills training; assist in CRP execution by collecting data, coordinating logistics, and
supporting research tasks; advise chaplains on observed morale and religious needs; perform administrative and supply functions for the CRP, including
tracking supplies, maintaining records, and supporting routine purchasing and logistics in coordination with chaplains, Religious Program Senior
Supervisors, and Religious Program Supervisors; and provide basic technical support for force protection requirements of Religious Ministry Teams (RMT)
operating in expeditionary and combat environments.

nlx_method: NLx employer-demand profiles; private-only ownership unverified. Six-digit profiles pool specialty weighted task incidences after the existing review exclusion mask and five-job task-support floor; destination SOCs require 200 postings and nonzero tasks. Military profiles use binary accepted task presence and the same NLx reference RCA weights as civilian profiles: reciprocal positive task shares (zero weight for reference-absent tasks) of pooled retained support-five NLx weighted incidences across 1,016 reference specialties (912 eligible comparison candidates), sqrt(q * rca_weight), then L2 normalization and cosine. No military crosswalk codes enter the task ranking. All positive top-20 results retained; zero-similarity destinations are not recommendations. Shared field/rating duties are included; general Naval Standards remain separate by paygrade.
